# mynetname.net
> Dynamic DNS service that lets users map changing IP addresses to stable hostnames and manage DNS records.

mynetname.net provides dynamic DNS hosting, account management, update clients, and support resources for keeping home servers, remote access, and self-hosted services reachable.

## Core Service
- [Home](https://www.mynetname.net/): Overview of the dynamic DNS service, account access, and primary site navigation.
- [Create Account](https://www.mynetname.net/create-account): Register a new account to create and manage dynamic DNS hostnames.
- [Login](https://www.mynetname.net/login): Sign in to manage hostnames, DNS settings, and account preferences.
- [Pricing](https://www.mynetname.net/pricing): Compare available plans and service limits for dynamic DNS usage.
- [Features](https://www.mynetname.net/features): Summary of supported DNS capabilities, hostname management, and service functionality.

## Dynamic DNS Management
- [Hostnames](https://www.mynetname.net/hostnames): Manage dynamic DNS hostnames associated with your account.
- [DNS Records](https://www.mynetname.net/dns-records): Configure DNS record types and hostname resolution settings.
- [Domains](https://www.mynetname.net/domains): View available domains and hostname options supported by the service.
- [Name Servers](https://www.mynetname.net/name-servers): Information about DNS infrastructure and nameserver configuration.
- [Update Settings](https://www.mynetname.net/update-settings): Configure how IP address updates are received and applied.

## Setup Guides
- [Getting Started](https://www.mynetname.net/getting-started): Introductory setup steps for creating and using a dynamic DNS hostname.
- [Router Setup](https://www.mynetname.net/router-setup): Configure supported routers to send dynamic DNS updates automatically.
- [Client Setup](https://www.mynetname.net/client-setup): Install and configure update clients on desktop or server systems.
- [Custom Domain Setup](https://www.mynetname.net/custom-domain-setup): Connect your own domain to the dynamic DNS service.
- [Remote Access Guide](https://www.mynetname.net/remote-access): Use dynamic DNS for home network and remote service access.

## API and Integration
- [API Overview](https://www.mynetname.net/api): Introduction to programmatic hostname and DNS update capabilities.
- [Update API](https://www.mynetname.net/api/update): Endpoint reference for submitting dynamic IP address updates.
- [Authentication](https://www.mynetname.net/api/authentication): Supported authentication methods for API and update requests.
- [API Examples](https://www.mynetname.net/api/examples): Sample requests for integrating clients, scripts, and devices.
- [Response Codes](https://www.mynetname.net/api/response-codes): Reference for interpreting update results and API error responses.

## Software and Clients
- [Downloads](https://www.mynetname.net/downloads): Access available update clients, tools, and related software packages.
- [Windows Client](https://www.mynetname.net/downloads/windows): Dynamic DNS update client for Windows systems.
- [Linux Client](https://www.mynetname.net/downloads/linux): Dynamic DNS update tools and instructions for Linux environments.
- [macOS Client](https://www.mynetname.net/downloads/macos): Update client options and setup guidance for macOS systems.
- [Device Integrations](https://www.mynetname.net/device-integrations): Compatibility information for routers, NAS devices, and network appliances.

## Help and Support
- [Support Center](https://www.mynetname.net/support): Central support resources for account, DNS, and update issues.
- [FAQ](https://www.mynetname.net/faq): Answers to common questions about setup, billing, and hostname management.
- [Knowledge Base](https://www.mynetname.net/knowledge-base): Troubleshooting and how-to articles for common service tasks.
- [Contact Support](https://www.mynetname.net/contact): Reach the support team for technical or account assistance.
- [Service Status](https://www.mynetname.net/status): Check current platform availability and operational status.

## Account and Billing
- [Account Settings](https://www.mynetname.net/account): Manage profile details, security settings, and account preferences.
- [Billing](https://www.mynetname.net/billing): Review subscriptions, invoices, and payment-related account information.
- [Subscription Plans](https://www.mynetname.net/plans): Details on plan tiers, included features, and usage allowances.
- [Password Reset](https://www.mynetname.net/password-reset): Recover account access and reset your login credentials.
- [Email Preferences](https://www.mynetname.net/email-preferences): Manage notification and communication settings.

## Policies and Legal
- [Terms of Service](https://www.mynetname.net/terms): Legal terms governing use of the dynamic DNS service.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.mynetname.net/privacy): How personal data is collected, used, and protected.
- [Acceptable Use Policy](https://www.mynetname.net/acceptable-use): Rules and restrictions for using the platform responsibly.
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.mynetname.net/cookies): Information about cookies and related tracking technologies.
- [Abuse Reporting](https://www.mynetname.net/abuse): Report misuse, malicious activity, or policy violations.
